source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    row_separators = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_separators = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1]

    def spans(size, separators):
        result = []
        start = 0
        for index in separators:
            if start < index:
                result.append((start, index))
            start = index + 1
        if start < size:
            result.append((start, size))
        return result

    row_spans = spans(len(grid), row_separators)
    col_spans = spans(len(grid[0]), col_separators)
    blocks = [[(r0, r1, c0, c1) for c0, c1 in col_spans] for r0, r1 in row_spans]
    separator_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in row_separators} | {grid[0][c] for c in col_separators}
    interior = [grid[r][c] for row in blocks for r0, r1, c0, c1 in [row] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
    colors = Counter(value for value in interior if value not in separator_colors)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[background if sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) == 1 else 1
             for c0, c1 in col_spans] for r0, r1 in row_spans]
'''
